answer.reason: The verses state several deeds and fates of Rezin beyond the summary: his war on Jerusalem, the recovery of Elath, and his death.

clauses.english: went up with Pekah to war against Jerusalem but could not overcome it
clauses.quote: came up to Jerusalem to war: and they besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him

clauses.english: recovered Elath for Syria and drove the Jews out of it
clauses.quote: Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drave the Jews from Elath

clauses.english: was slain when the king of Assyria took Damascus
clauses.quote: went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried the people of it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin

doubts: ISA 8:6 and ISA 9:11 are prophecies and are not used as events.
The first clause joins one joint campaign told in two books, treated as one event.
